feed.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Refreshing the Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) review team is highlighted as a more effective approach than reducing expectations for the quality or thoroughness of BIP reviews. The emphasis remains on maintaining high standards in evaluating proposals, ensuring that the review process continues to uphold the integrity and advancement of the Bitcoin protocol.
A willingness to take on greater responsibility as a BIP Editor is expressed, backed by experience in contributing to major Bitcoin projects, including bitcoindevkit and ongoing work with Bitcoin Core since 2024. This continuous involvement is currently supported through an OpenSats grant, demonstrating both commitment and active participation in the ecosystem.
Support is also extended for Edil to join the editorial team, citing his strong technical review skills, meticulous attention to detail, and valuable academic background. His methodical approach and experience with peer review are considered assets that would contribute positively to the quality of BIP evaluations.
